summary.en: A pencil dimension draws between two points of a print, ticks at both ends, and lands with a chip of the computed difference while the rest of the print steps back.
summary.zh: 铅笔尺寸线在截图上两点之间画出，两端短刻线，落定时带出计算得到的差值标签，截图其余部分退后。

fits: The gap between two values on one chart or table, measured on the asset’s own axis.
notFor: Values on different prints; a gap that is not on an axis.

intent.en: Measure the gap on the evidence itself, so the difference is seen, not asserted.
intent.zh: 在证据本身上量出差距，让差值被看见，而不是被宣称。

content.en: Two points on the print (file px) and their two values; a label pattern (`{diff}`, `{ratio}`).
content.zh: 截图上的两个点（文件像素）和它们的两个值；标签模板（`{diff}`、`{ratio}`）。

fits.zh: 同一张图表或表格上两个值之间的差距，在素材自己的坐标轴上测量。

notFor.zh: 不在同一张截图上的值；不在坐标轴上的差距。

pairs.note: the scene that plays it as the climax

en: Compute the label from the two values; never type it.
zh: 标签由两个值计算，不手写。

fits: any launch argued from published evidence

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
